sponsored.t: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises
sponsored.sum: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit information on multifamily housing premiums and claims paid to the department of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit information on multifamily housing premiums and claims paid to the department of financial services.

sponsored.t: Requires vehicle rental agreements instruct renters to remove personal information before returning the vehicle and permits rental vehicles to have decals informing the renter to remove such information
sponsored.sum: Requires rental vehicles have any personal information removed from the vehicle once returned.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"; regulates the submission and determinations of applications for ownership of cooperative apartments.

sponsored.t: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for SCRIE, DRIE, SCHE and DHE by any increase in the consumer price index
sponsored.sum: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE), disability rent increase exemption (DRIE), senior citizen homeowners' exemption (SCHE), and disabled homeowners' exemption (DHE) by any increase in the consumer price index (CPI).

sponsored.t: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity
sponsored.sum: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity to six gigawatts by the year 2030, twelve gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2040, and seventeen gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2050.

sponsored.t: Permits localities to opt to reduce renters' payments towards rent to one-third of household income for eligible participants in the SCRIE and DRIE programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a maximum rent of one-third of household income for the senior citizens rent increase exemption and disability rent increase exemption.

sponsored.t: Includes households who are fleeing or attempting to flee domestic violence under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program
sponsored.sum: Includes households who are fleeing or attempting to flee domestic violence under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program.

sponsored.t: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle
sponsored.sum: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings; authorizes utility companies or municipalities to commence an action against the owner of the premises affected to seek the appointment of a receiver of rents or payments for use and occupancy or common charges.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain data to the department of financial services and authorizes premium discounts to policyholders who demonstrate certain mitigation actions
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain zip code-level data to the department of financial services on nonrenewal rates, nonpayment cancellation rates, other cancellation rates, claim frequency rates, average claim amounts, paid loss ratios, and average premiums; requires property/casualty insurance companies that use a natural disaster risk model or scoring method to assign risk, information about such model or scoring method; authorizes a premium discount to policyholders of homeowners insurance or property/casualty insurance applicable to residential real property who demonstrate certain mitigation actions; requires insurers to post about such discounts on their…

sponsored.t: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice
sponsored.sum: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice; provides that after December 31, 2028 individuals certified as an instructor in small arms practice shall seek recertification subject to the standards and curriculum promulgated by the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain alterations to multiple dwellings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain alterations based upon which room is being altered in a multiple dwelling.

sponsored.t: Relates to energy efficiency improvements and certain alterations to multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Provides for energy efficiency improvements to certain windows; relates to certain alterations concerning windows and HVAC equipment in multiple dwellings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers of the New York state housing finance agency
sponsored.sum: Makes certain powers of the New York state housing finance agency permanent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

sponsored.t: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia
sponsored.sum: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia for an additional four years.

sponsored.t: Establishes the homeownership protection program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the homeowner protection program; provides that the department of law shall establish the homeowner protection program to ensure the availability of free housing counseling and legal services to homeowners for the purposes of mitigating threats to homeownership; provides that the department of law shall provide grants to eligible not-for-profit housing counseling organizations and legal services organizations to provide services under the program.

sponsored.t: Establishes maximum contaminant levels and a hazard index in drinking water for certain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)
sponsored.sum: Establishes maximum contaminant levels in drinking water for certain per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS); sets such levels at no higher than 4 parts per trillion (ppt) for perfluorooctane sulfonic acid (PFOS) and perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA) and no higher than 10 parts per trillion (ppt) for perfluorononanoic acid (PFNA), perfluorohexane sulfonate (PFHxS), and hexafluoropropylene oxide dimer acid (HFPO-DA).

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a school or place of worship
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property within Manhattan in the city of New York from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a school or place of worship.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area; provides for a rebate program; provides for a process for application and certification.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law.

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation
sponsored.sum: Increases the maximum aggregate principal amount of the outstanding notes and bonds of the New York city housing development corporation from twenty billion dollars to twenty-two billion dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns; requires the division of state police to maintain statewide records of individuals who have waived the right to purchase firearms, rifles, or shotguns and any revocations of such waivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing consumer debt collectors
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing consumer debt collectors; sets minimum standards and regulations; establishes penalties for violations.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal implications of this bill would be minimal and would be expected to be absorbed within the Department of Financial Services' administrative resources.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the rent emergency stabilization for tenants act on local determinations of a housing emergency
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting the rent emergency stabilization for tenants act on local determinations of a housing emergency; authorizes a city with a population of one million or more to declare an emergency as to any class of housing accommodations if the vacancy rate for the housing accommodations in such class within such municipality is not in excess of five percent and a declaration of emergency may be made as to all housing accommodations if the vacancy rate for the housing accommodations within such municipality is not in excess of five percent; authorizes other cities, towns and villages to declare a housing emergency after considering publicly available data and holding public hearings.

sponsored.t: Permits multiple transfers of low-income housing tax credits
sponsored.sum: Permits multiple transfers of low-income housing tax credits.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring agencies to report information about FOIL inquiries to the committee on open government
sponsored.sum: Requires all agencies to submit to the committee on open government a log of all freedom of information law requests for each year in which they received or have pending a request for records; requires the committee on open government to publish, on one webpage, all freedom of information law request logs it receives.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "extended producer responsibility for artificial turf act of 2026"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "extended producer responsibility for artificial turf act".
sponsored.fis: No significant net costs to the State. Program costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to energy efficiency and weatherization
sponsored.ls: New York State Energy Research and Development Act
sponsored.sum: Directs NYSERDA to issue a request for proposals to identify cities, towns, or villages that are interested in participating in municipal-level energy efficiency and weatherization pilot projects to help decrease residential energy usage and reduce future capital costs for utilities; directs NYSERDA to identify three pilot areas focusing on the ability to replicate projects elsewhere and the costs and benefits to ratepayers both in the affected area and in the rest of the utility service territory.

sponsored.t: Enacts the washing our clothes without polluting our water act
sponsored.sum: Makes provisions for washing machine microfiber filtration to reduce water pollution.

sponsored.t: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance.

sponsored.t: Repeals provisions of the administrative code of the city of New York relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula.

sponsored.t: Enacts the  climate accountability and loss recovery act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "climate accountability and loss recovery act"; provides that the attorney general may bring a civil action against a covered entity for recovery of certain costs and assessments arising from a climate disaster.

sponsored.t: Requires notification of firearm denials to local law enforcement and the local prosecutor having jurisdiction where the prohibited person sought to acquire the firearm
sponsored.sum: Requires notification of firearm denials to local law enforcement and the local prosecutor having jurisdiction where the prohibited person sought to acquire the firearm; requires local law enforcement to initiate a criminal investigation within five business days.

sponsored.t: Relates to the docketing of judgments imposing civil penalties for the violation of certain requirements imposed by the zoning resolution of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the docketing of judgments imposing civil penalties for the violation of certain requirements imposed by the zoning resolution of the city of New York; makes other technical changes.

sponsored.t: Extends the answer time when a major capital improvement rent increase has been filed to ninety days
sponsored.sum: Extends the answer time when a major capital improvement rent increase has been filed to ninety days.

sponsored.t: Provides protections against illegal voter purging
sponsored.sum: Provides protections against illegal voter purging.

sponsored.t: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials
sponsored.sum: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials; requires the uniform building code to set standards for salvage lumber; requires the secretary of state to develop a program for grading salvage lumber for structural purposes.

sponsored.t: Provides for children under the age of eighteen to wear protective headgear while skiing or snowboarding
sponsored.sum: Requires children under the age of eighteen to wear protective headgear while skiing or snowboarding; imposes civil fines for violations thereof; applies safety in skiing code requirements to snowboarders and snowboarding.

sponsored.t: Relates to the closure of nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the closure of nursing homes.
sponsored.fis: Minimal fiscal impact to the state and none to local governments.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain residents of the central business district from central business district tolls
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to exempt certain residents of the central business district from the central business district toll.

sponsored.t: Establishes the build up New York pilot program and the mass timber for affordable housing program to encourage the use of mass timber in affordable housing retrofits and additions
sponsored.sum: Establishes the build up New York pilot program to provide grants to eligible municipalities that construct new accessory dwelling unit housing projects built on top of existing buildings that utilize mass timber and serve certain households; establishes the mass timber for affordable housing program to provide tax credits for eligible taxpayers who use mass timber in certain new construction or major retrofits of existing buildings that primarily serve households up to one hundred fifty percent of the area median income; establishes tax credits for mass timber production.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for gas cylinders
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for gas cylinders; provides that no later than December 31, 2029 a producer shall submit a plan for the establishment of a collection program for gas cylinders.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to the state, with the expectation that costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Requires publicly funded ferries to be zero-emission and directs NYSERDA to conduct a feasibility study related to transitioning certain workboats to be zero-emission
sponsored.sum: Requires all ferries purchased by or for the state or any agency or public authority thereof, in any fiscal year which commences on or after April 1, 2028, produce zero emissions; directs NYSERDA to conduct a feasibility study related to transitioning certain workboats to be zero-emission; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the use of a water demand calculator in new construction and substantial renovations and establishing an advisory board to monitor such usage
sponsored.sum: Provides that the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code shall address standards requiring the use of a water demand calculator to determine pipe and fixture sizing for use in new construction and substantial renovations of single-family and multi-unit residential buildings; directs the chairperson of the state fire prevention and building code council to appoint an advisory board to monitor the use of water demand calculators in new construction and substantial renovations and to monitor and keep records of cost savings resulting from the use of such water demand calculators.

sponsored.t: Expands the state rental registry identifying lead hazards to include all residential dwellings meeting certain conditions
sponsored.sum: Expands the state rental registry identifying lead hazards to include all residential dwellings that are potentially eligible for rental, lease, let or hiring out, and are located within communities of concern.

sponsored.t: Requires a procedure for notification when a family member applies and is denied by a limited-profit housing company to succeed a lease or occupancy agreement
sponsored.sum: Requires a procedure for notification of a family member of a tenant or cooperator in the case that their application to succeed a lease or occupancy agreement is denied by a limited-profit housing company.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the Neighborhood Small Business Rent Increase Exemption
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the Neighborhood Small Business Rent Increase Exemption; provides a tax abatement for limiting rent increases on small businesses in a city of one million or more persons.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for textiles
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for textiles; requires a producer, either individually or cooperatively in a group or with a representative organization to submit to the department of environmental conservation a plan for the establishment of a collection program for textile covered products.
sponsored.fis: : No significant net costs to the State. Program costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Provides for direct-pay tax abatement credits for solar electric generating systems and electric energy storage systems in connection with eligible buildings
sponsored.sum: Provides for direct-pay tax abatement credits for solar electric generating systems and electric energy storage systems in connection with eligible buildings; provides such eligible properties shall include: 501(c)(3) corporations, associations, organizations or trusts and income-restricted affordable housing properties.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee based on the frequency of payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for making monthly, semi-monthly, and biweekly payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments.

sponsored.t: Relates to the standards for openable windows in residential units
sponsored.sum: Requires openable windows in residential units to comply with certain mechanical ventilation standards.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact on the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing a reduction of taxes pursuant to shelter rent
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing a reduction of taxes pursuant to shelter rent; provides that upon consent of the local legislative body in a city with a population of one million or more such taxes may be reduced to five per centum or less, including a full reduction of the annual shelter rent or carrying charges of a project.

sponsored.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with stopping requirements at intersections in violation of section 1174 of the vehicle and traffic law
sponsored.sum: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with stopping requirements at intersections in violation of section 1174 of the vehicle and traffic law; relates to access to records.

sponsored.t: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district
sponsored.sum: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "bird safe buildings act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "bird safe buildings act" directing the commissioner of general services to incorporate practices and strategies to reduce bird fatality resulting from collisions with certain state-owned or state-leased buildings, and for other purposes; requires the commissioner to develop a design guide that includes features, methods and strategies, and best practices for reducing bird fatalities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "low-carbon building construction act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "low-carbon building construction act"; relates to requiring construction of any building, addition or renovation greater than 25,000 square feet meet certain standards intended to reduce the embodied carbon emissions associated with the construction.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"; requires each gas corporation, electric corporation, or combination gas or electric corporation to submit to the public service commission for review and approval at least one and up to ten neighborhood scale weatherization and electrification-ready projects.

sponsored.t: Authorizes residential cooperative corporations to offer health insurance
sponsored.sum: Authorizes residential cooperative corporations to offer health insurance.

sponsored.t: Requires real estate brokers and salespersons to compile and disclose client demographic data to the secretary of state
sponsored.sum: Requires real estate brokers and salespersons to compile and disclose client demographic data to the secretary of state; requires real estate brokers and salespersons to request the voluntary disclosure of demographic information from clients and record and retain such information for a period of two years.
sponsored.fis: There will be costs associated with collecting, maintaining, and publishing data incurred by the Secretary of State.

sponsored.t: Relates to the clergy property tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Permits local governments to extend the existing clergy residential property tax exemption to include clergy residing in co-ops; clarifies that the clergy property tax exemption shall not affect eligibility for certain other tax abatements.
sponsored.fis: None to the state. No effect on local governments unless they opt-in to the extension of the law to include coops; such local governments that opt-in will see a very small reduction in overall property tax revenue.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the pass-through or transfer of the credits for rehabilitation of historic properties
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the pass-through or transfer of the credits for rehabilitation of historic properties; authorizes the allocation of the credit in a separate manner from any federal certified historic tax credit.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control
sponsored.sum: Prohibits surcharges on self-installed dishwashers in housing accommodations subject to rent control when the tenant pays for electric utility service.

sponsored.t: Establishes the historic preservation tax credit transfer program
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Establishes the historic preservation tax credit transfer program to provide flexibility and incentives for businesses which rehabilitate historic properties to further promote the development of affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"; prohibits certain food additives and food color additives; provides that in an action to enforce compliance, the recognition by the federal food and drug administration of any of these substances as safe may not be alleged as a defense; establishes requirements for the reporting of GRAS (generally recognized as safe) substances.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of foods containing synthetic color additives in schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of foods containing synthetic color additives in schools except under certain circumstances off and away from the premises or on premises at least a half hour after the end of the school day.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs; provides that the commissioner of environmental conservation shall provide grants to the New York city community board with jurisdiction over the site or to any not-for-profit corporation exempt from taxation under section 501(c)(3) of the internal revenue code at any site which may be affected by a brownfield site remedial program.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency to certain graduates of post secondary programs or comparable apprenticeship and workforce training programs for the purchase of certain property.

sponsored.t: Prevents the harassment of a rent regulated tenant
sponsored.sum: Creates a presumption that certain harassing acts by an owner are intended to cause a tenant to vacate their dwelling units or to surrender or waive any rights in relation to such occupancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enactment of the student journalism education act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the student journalist education act to protect student speech at educational institutions unless such speech is libelous, an invasion of privacy, or incites students to commit an unlawful act, violate school policies, or to materially and substantially disrupt the orderly operation of the school.
sponsored.fis: This legislation will have no fiscal implications for State or local government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears
sponsored.sum: Relates to the payment of shelter and rent arrears; provides that all shelter arrears payments authorized for applicants to receive an emergency grant to pay for rent, property taxes or mortgage arrears shall be limited to once every year unless the district determines at its discretion that additional shelter arrears payments are necessary based on the individual circumstances.
sponsored.fis: Both additional expenditures for increased effectiveness in providing emergency assistance, and savings from reduced costs of shelter and other services to be determined

sponsored.t: Relates to wrongful refusal of admission to and ejection from places of public entertainment and amusement
sponsored.sum: Includes sporting events within the definition of places of public entertainment and amusement for purposes of wrongful refusal of admission to and ejection from places of public entertainment and amusement.

sponsored.t: Requires fashion sellers to be accountable to standardized environmental and social due diligence policies, and establishes a fashion remediation fund
sponsored.sum: Requires fashion sellers to carry out environmental due diligence for the portions of their business related to wearing apparel, footwear or fashion bags, including wearing apparel, footwear or fashion bags produced as a private label; establishes a fashion remediation fund.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state healthy and green procurement act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state healthy and green procurement act".

sponsored.t: Relates to the reuse of building construction, deconstruction, and demolition, materials
sponsored.sum: Relates to the reuse of building construction, deconstruction, and demolition materials, including requiring local deconstruction ordinances and reporting requirements for local political subdivisions awarded grants for construction, deconstruction and demolition projects; establishes a construction, deconstruction, and demolition waste prevention and reduction grant and technical support program; establishes deconstruction contractor certification requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to priority applicants and inspection of units under the housing access voucher pilot program
sponsored.sum: Relates to priority applicants and inspection of units under the housing access voucher pilot program; provides that priority shall be given both to applicants who are homeless and who are at risk of losing their federal rental subsidy; provides that housing access voucher local administrators shall inspect units for which a housing assistance payment contract is established.

sponsored.t: Establishes a subpart to hear eviction matters related to affordable housing providers and small landlords
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a subpart to hear eviction matters related to affordable housing providers and small landlords; provides a subpart shall be in each borough of the city of New York; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to mortgage loan servicers
sponsored.sum: Provides that any person who has been injured by reason of any violation of any such rules, regulations or policies as the superintendent may promulgate may bring an action in such person's own name; assert a counterclaim; or, if an action is commenced by the mortgagee or anyone acting on its behalf, bring a third party claim, against either the mortgagee and/or the mortgage servicer to enjoin any violations thereof; authorizes damages; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing extended producer responsibility for tires
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing extended producer responsibility for tires; provides that no later than June 30, 2027 a producer shall submit a plan for the establishment of a collection program for tires; establishes the tire extended producer responsibility fund.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to the state, with the expectation that costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Requires at least one director on a board of directors be a primary resident of the residential cooperative housing corporation and prohibits certain charges by such corporations without 30 days notice
sponsored.sum: Requires at least one director on a board of directors of a residential cooperative housing corporation be a primary resident of such residential cooperative housing corporation; prohibits the charging of payments, fees or charges by cooperative housing corporations without thirty days written notice to such cooperative housing corporation's shareholders.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring municipalities to determine whether it is in the public interest to create and periodically update a comprehensive plan
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities to determine whether it is in the public interest to create a comprehensive plan adapted to the special requirements of the municipality and to determine whether it is in the public interest to update such comprehensive plan at least once every ten years to ensure that such plan addresses housing needs.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the Chambers St 1/2/3 subway station to the Chambers St-Borough of Manhattan Community College station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the Chambers St 1/2/3 subway station to the Chambers St-Borough of Manhattan Community College station.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a tax abatement for alterations and improvements to multiple dwellings for purposes of preserving habitability in affordable housing
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a tax abatement for alterations and improvements to multiple dwellings for purposes of preserving habitability in affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "washing machine microfiber filtration act"
sponsored.sum: Requires washing machines sold after a certain date to contain a microfiber filtration system that meets certain specifications.

sponsored.t: Relates to arbitration organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to arbitration organizations; requires private arbitration organizations involved in fifty or more consumer arbitrations per year to collect, publish at least quarterly, and make available to the public in a computer-searchable database certain information relating to such arbitrations; prohibits financial conflicts of interest.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a new acquisition fund for community land trusts located in New York state
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a new acquisition fund for community land trusts located in New York state; provides that moneys of the fund shall be expended solely to carry out the affordable home ownership development program exclusively for community land trusts; defines community land trusts.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment of a rent regulated tenant
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of aggravated harassment of a rent regulated tenant which occurs when an owner intentionally engages in a systematic ongoing course of conduct to induce three or more rent regulated tenants occupying different housing accommodations in two or more residential buildings to vacate such housing accommodations or if such owner commits the crime of harassment of a rent regulated tenant and was previously convicted of the same crime in the past five years.

sponsored.t: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program which shall provide grants within amounts appropriated or otherwise available therefor to affordable independent senior housing properties to establish and operate resident assistance programs.
sponsored.fis: None. This program would be subject to annual appropriations.

sponsored.t: Relates to enforcement of provisions regarding regulation of tobacco products, herbal cigarettes, and smoking paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Amends the effective date of a 2025 chapter relating to enforcement of provisions regarding regulation of tobacco products, herbal cigarettes, and smoking paraphernalia.

sponsored.t: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling
sponsored.sum: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling.
sponsored.fis: Impacts are expected to be minimal.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for failure to comply with maintenance and reporting of vacant and abandoned properties, and reporting and release of information
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for failure to comply with maintenance and reporting of vacant and abandoned properties, and reporting and release of information; provides for the sharing of information between municipalities; provides for enforcement for failure to report on abandoned and vacant properties.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid for social services districts located in a municipality with a population of five million or more
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid for social services districts located in a municipality with a population of five million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes
sponsored.sum: Provides for state assistance to local governments for the enforcement of fire prevention and building codes using monies paid into the code enforcement account.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a statewide residential rental registry
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a statewide residential rental registry providing information relating to rental units including the number and types of code violations issued by the appropriate enforcement agency, and the number of findings of harassment currently on record with the code enforcement agencies.

sponsored.t: Requires certain watercraft, aircraft, and trains to be zero emissions; requires the study of certain clean energy sources; requires certain monetary incentives for clean energy vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires certain watercraft, aircrafts, and trains to use clean energy, including ensuring such vehicles are zero-emissions; requires NYSERDA to study zero-emission commercial vehicles, the use of renewable energy in publicly funded airports, and the use of sustainable aviation fuel; requires NYSERDA to administer a grant program to flying schools and clubs that install charging infrastructure.

sponsored.t: Relates to the composition of boards of elections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the composition of boards of elections; provides that such boards shall have other qualifications for performing their duties as the legislature may direct.

sponsored.t: Relates to interest rates imposed on late payment of property taxes and delinquencies
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing counties to set interest rates imposed on late payment of property taxes and delinquencies and redemption of property subject to more than one tax lien.

sponsored.t: Requires residential real property managers to be licensed by secretary of state
sponsored.sum: Requires residential real property managers or any firm employing a property manager, contracting with a property manager or contracting to provide a property manager to file a registration statement with the secretary of state and to be certified from an approved certifying organization.
sponsored.fis: The Secretary of state shall collect a $50 fee with each registration.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program; provides that the commissioner of the division of housing and community renewal shall implement a program of rental assistance in the form of housing vouchers for eligible individuals and families who are homeless or who face an imminent loss of housing; provides that the commissioner shall designate housing access voucher local administrators in the state to administer the program.
sponsored.fis: The fiscal implications to the State would be subject to the amounts appropriated for the program through the State budget process. The program would probably reduce costs currently borne by localities, for shelter and other services they currently provide to homeless individ- uals and families.

sponsored.t: Relates to offenses involving thefts of identity; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to offenses involving theft of identity; creates five tiers of crimes, based on the financial loss to the victim(s) and the number of people victimized.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the release of certain balloons
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the release of certain balloons; prohibits a person from knowingly or intentionally releasing outdoors any balloons constructed of electrically conductive material filled with helium or a gas lighter than air; provides exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to political contribution activities by an intermediary
sponsored.sum: Regulates political contribution activities by intermediaries; requires disclosure of certain identifying information when certain contributions are made by an intermediary to a candidate or a committee.
sponsored.fis: Very minor one-time costs associated with adjustments to the campaign finance disclosure systems administered by the State Board of Elections.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for cage-free egg production
sponsored.sum: Requires a farm owner or operator that produces shell eggs or liquid eggs for human consumption to confine egg-laying hens in a cage-free housing system.

sponsored.t: Discontinues certain real property tax exemptions for real property used for major league sports teams
sponsored.sum: Discontinues the real property tax exemption for certain real property that is used for home games for certain professional sports teams in New York city beginning with the 2026 assessment roll.

sponsored.t: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status
sponsored.sum: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status; provides that local social services districts in a city with a population of five million or more shall be permitted to offer certain housing programs to individuals or families who would be eligible but for a federal law restricting eligibility based on immigration.
sponsored.fis: Some additional cost for CityFHEPS vouchers, partly or perhaps fully offset by savings in shelter costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the unlawful purchase and sale of body armor
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of unlawful purchase of body armor in the first and second degree; establishes the crimes of unlawful sale of body armor in the first and second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent impairing violations and eviction proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to rent impairing violations and eviction proceedings.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for household appliances and refrigerants
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for household appliances and refrigerants; provides that no later than December 31, 2027, producers shall submit a plan to the department of environmental conservation for the establishment of a collection program for certain covered products.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to the state, with the expectation that costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for designated products
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for designated products; establishes the extended producer responsibility program fund.
sponsored.fis: The State costs of any EPR programs for products designated pursuant to the new title would be borne by the producers; localities would likely save money on disposal costs.

sponsored.t: Requires municipalities to include a housing needs assessment using the HUD median income calculations in their comprehensive plans
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities to include an Affordable Housing Needs Assessment to establish a data-based foundation for the creation and preservation of affordable housing in the municipality, utilizing the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development median income calculations, in their comprehensive plans.

sponsored.t: Establishes new targets for offshore wind electricity generation
sponsored.sum: Establishes new targets for offshore wind electricity generation; includes the requirements that there is at least 15 gigawatts of offshore wind electricity generation by 2040, at least 18 gigawatts of offshore wind electricity generation by 2045 and at least 20 gigawatts of offshore wind electricity generation by 2050.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning
sponsored.sum: Requires high-sugar beverages to be labeled with a safety warning stating that the beverage contains 100% or more of the FDA recommended daily intake of added sugar.

sponsored.t: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check and authorizes the denial of a firearm license for applicants under thirty who committed certain offenses as a juvenile
sponsored.sum: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check; authorizes the denial of a firearm license for an applicant who is under the age of thirty and who as a juvenile was adjudicated delinquent for an offense which, if committed by an adult, would constitute a felony or serious offense.

sponsored.t: Changes the date of designation for election inspectors and poll clerks
sponsored.sum: Changes the date of designation for election inspectors and poll clerks to January first.

sponsored.t: Requires the board of directors of a cooperative housing corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of directors of a residential cooperative housing corporation to notify applicants seeking to purchase shares of the corporation of the reason or reasons the board of directors has refused such request.

sponsored.t: Allows a person to institute an action for a violation of the provisions of the environmental quality review even if the injury does not affect the public at large
sponsored.sum: Prevents individuals from being denied standing in private actions alleging violations of the environmental quality review provisions of the environmental conservation law solely on the basis that the injury alleged by such individual does not differ in kind or degree from the injury that would be suffered by the public at large.
sponsored.fis: None to state and local governments.

sponsored.t: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check
sponsored.sum: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check for an applicant who is under the age of twenty-two.

sponsored.t: Relates to assessments of residential cooperative, condominium and rental property
sponsored.sum: Relates to assessments of residential cooperative, condominium and rental property; defines the term "the assessment which would be placed upon such parcel were the parcel not owned or leased by a cooperative corporation or on a condominium basis".

sponsored.t: Requires restaurants and persons authorized to sell alcoholic beverages to have tangible menus available upon request
sponsored.sum: Requires restaurants and persons authorized to sell alcoholic beverages to have tangible menus available upon request.

sponsored.t: Creates an affordable housing relief fund program to preserve affordable multifamily residential properties located in New York state
sponsored.sum: Creates an affordable housing relief fund program to preserve affordable multifamily residential properties located in New York state.
sponsored.fis: To be determined. Program funding would be subject to amounts appropri- ated, or otherwise available.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an office of antibiotic resistance control and to establishing the antibiotics education fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an office of antibiotic-resistance control; establishes the antibiotics education fund; includes methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and other antibiotic-resistant infections in the definition of airborne infectious disease.

sponsored.t: Requires certain business recipients of state aid to perform an annual assessment of the business' social and environmental impact as assessed against a third party standard
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Requires certain business recipients of state aid to perform an annual assessment of the business' social and environmental impact as assessed against a third party standard.

sponsored.t: Diminishes certain limitations and restrictions on emergency assistance to pay rent arrears and removes the requirement that such assistance be repaid by the recipient
sponsored.sum: Diminishes certain limitations and restrictions on emergency assistance to pay rent arrears; removes the requirement that such assistance be repaid by the recipient.

sponsored.t: Requires the board of elections or a bipartisan committee to conduct a risk-limiting audit of voter verifiable audit records
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections or a bipartisan committee appointed by such board to conduct a risk-limiting audit of voter verifiable audit records from voting machines or systems within the jurisdiction of such board.
sponsored.fis: Some costs associated with the development and implementation of the regulations required by this legislation.

sponsored.t: Relates to budget planning
sponsored.sum: Clarifies certain provisions relating to the prohibition on budget planning; allows the attorney general to apply for an order enjoining or restraining commission or continuance of violations.

sponsored.t: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages
sponsored.sum: Requires the administration and the instruction in preparation of the TASC examination in the Chinese and Korean languages for pupils who are proficient in these languages and of limited English proficiency.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of lead-based paint test reports in real estate transactions
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of lead-based paint test reports in real estate transactions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "corporate political activity accountability to shareholders act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "corporate political activity accountability to shareholders act"; requires that corporate contributions to a political candidate or party committee or in support or opposition to a candidate or ballot referendum be approved by a majority of shareholders; applies to cooperative corporations, not-for-profit corporations, railroad and transportation corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the online consumer protection act
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the online consumer protection act; defines terms; provides that an advertising network shall post clear and conspicuous notice on the home page of its own website about its privacy policy and its data collection and use practices related to its advertising delivery activities; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a closed-circuit television system and surveillance personal privacy act
sponsored.sum: Establishes a public authority closed-circuit television system and surveillance personal privacy act, a state highway closed-circuit television system and surveillance personal privacy act and a municipal closed-circuit television system and surveillance personal privacy act; requires localities authorized to install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices to adopt and enforce measures to protect privacy.
sponsored.fis: 2024:S637(Kavanagh) -REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS 2023:S637(Kavanagh)-REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS 2022:S3089(Kavanagh)- REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS 2021:S3089(Kavanagh)- REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS 2020:S2332(Kavanagh)- REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS 2019:S2332(Kavanagh)- REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS 2018:S7130(Kavanagh)- REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS,AUTHORITIES AND COMMIS- SIONS

sponsored.t: Enacts the "digital fairness act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "digital fairness act"; requires any entity that conducts business in New York and maintains the personal information of 500 or more individuals to provide meaningful notice about their use of personal information; establishes unlawful discriminatory practices relating to targeted advertising.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the possession of certain 50 caliber firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting the possession of certain 50 caliber firearms; directs the division of state police to embark on a program whereby persons currently in lawful possession of such weapons may be reimbursed for the fair market value thereof upon turning in such weapons to a designated officer.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "shelter arrears eviction forestallment act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "shelter arrears eviction forestallment act" to provide emergency assistance for rent or mortgage arrears or other fees for the prevention of eviction.

sponsored.t: Expands tax fraud acts to include certain acts of fraud under title two of article four of the real property tax law
sponsored.sum: Allows real property tax fraud to be prosecuted by expanding tax fraud acts to cover certain acts of fraud under title two of article four of the real property tax law.

sponsored.t: Requires each town, village, and city to develop a "housing action plan for everyone"
sponsored.sum: Requires each town, village, and city to develop a "housing action plan for everyone", including consideration of local needs and specific strategies to address those local needs.

sponsored.t: Relates to determining when a dwelling is abandoned
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to determining when a dwelling is abandoned.

sponsored.t: Relates to qualified energy storage systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to qualified energy storage systems; authorizes energy storage permitting under the office of renewable energy siting and electric transmission.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing extended producer responsibility for electric and hybrid vehicle batteries
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing extended producer responsibility for electric and hybrid vehicle batteries; provides that no later than June 30, 2026 a producer shall submit a plan for the establishment of a collection program for electric or hybrid vehicle batteries; establishes the electric and hybrid vehicle batteries extended producer responsibility fund.
sponsored.fis: Minimal to the state, with the expectation that costs will be fully covered by fees generated by the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to applications for registration and enrollment of voters
sponsored.sum: Removes certain restrictions relating to applications for registration and enrollment of voters.

sponsored.t: Authorizes covered agencies and authorities to use weigh-in-motion technology to automatically enforce vehicle weight limits on their facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes covered agencies and authorities to use weigh-in-motion technology to automatically enforce vehicle weight limits on their facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions upon a subordinate bond or note
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions upon a subordinate bond or note; provides a statute of limitations for such actions.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "sustainable building materials act of 2025"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "sustainable building materials act"; enacts into law components of legislation relating to reducing greenhouse gas emissions in construction; provides a sales tax exemption for certain low-carbon building materials (Part A); establishes a grant program for manufacturers of concrete for environmental product declarations (Part B).

sponsored.t: Authorizes a surcharge for the issuance of permits relating to the obstruction or closure of a street or pedestrian plaza for construction purposes in a city having a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a surcharge for the issuance of permits relating to the obstruction or closure of a street or pedestrian plaza for construction purposes in a city having a population of one million or more and to the imposition of such surcharge.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or leak prone
sponsored.sum: Requires gas pipeline facilities to accelerate the repair, rehabilitation, and replacement of equipment or pipelines that are leaking or leak prone and increase safety reporting relating to gas pipeline leaks; requires the public service commission to establish timelines for the repair, rehabilitation or replacement of leaking or leak prone infrastructure; requires the commission to provide a gas safety report to the legislature.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York Ireland trade commission
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state Ireland trade commission.
sponsored.fis: 2024: S7083 (Kennedy)- Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business 2023: S7083 (Kennedy) - Commerce, Economic Development and Small Busi- ness

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of a facial recognition system by a landlord on any residential premises
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of a facial recognition system by a landlord on any residential premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling
sponsored.sum: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling; adds a battery used as the principal electric power source for an electric scooter or bicycle with electric assist to the definition of "rechargeable battery"; provides that a battery manufacturer may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute rechargeable batteries in the state unless the battery manufacturer is implementing or participating under an approved plan; allows a city with a population of one million or more to enforce through its own agencies.
sponsored.fis: New York State is likely to save a significant but undetermined amount due to reduced printing and mailing costs.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 87 Chapter 712 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 73-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to rechargeable battery recycling" APPROVED This bill proposes technical and substantive changes to the New York State Rechargeable Battery Recycling Law. The legislation includes elec- tric scooter and e-bike batteries as covered batteries under the stat- ute, as well as increasing the weight of rechargeable dry-cell batteries included in the program. It also clarifies what types of batteries retailers must accept, and it prohibits retailers from selling recharge- able batteries unless battery manufacturers operate in accordance with an approved plan. The bill includes timelines for compliance, requires manufacturers to submit a new or updated plan, and explicitly prohibits manufacturers from selling into the state unless…

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 156 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 1778-C, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to granting members of the city's police force eligibil- ity for retirement and pension based on previous service as traf- fic enforcement agents" Assembly Bill Number 6756, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to providing certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assist- ant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange coun- ty" Assembly Bill Number 6942, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to the restoration of 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation…

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs; provides that the commissioner of environmental conservation shall provide grants to the New York city community board with jurisdiction over the site or to any not-for-profit corporation exempt from taxation under section 501(c)(3) of the internal revenue code at any site which may be affected by a brownfield site remedial program.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 113 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 4263, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs" NOT APPROVED This bill would require an applicant to the Brownfield Cleanup Program (BCP) to provide a technical assistance grant to the community if there is a significant threat to public health or the environment or the site is near a school or daycare, regardless of whether they are a responsi- ble party. In other instances, the Department of Environmental Conserva- tion (DEC) may provide this technical assistance grant. The bill also changes any reference of "citizen participation" to "community partic- ipation." I continue to support the goal of this bill to provide grants and meaningfully…

sponsored.t: Requires the board of elections in a city with a population of one million or more to provide certain notices prior to a change of polling place
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections in a city with a population of one million or more to notify by mail state and county party committees and certain elected officials prior to a change of polling place.

sponsored.t: Defines enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Defines enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia; provides that an enforcement officer for purposes of section 1399-ee of the public health law shall be the office of administrative trials and hearings.
sponsored.fis: This bill will have no fiscal impact for the State.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 8 Chapter 551 MEMORANDUM filed with Senate Bill Number 5624, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to defining enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia" APPROVED This bill would expand the definition of "enforcement officer" under Article 13-F of the Public Health Law, which regulates tobacco products, herbal cigarettes, and smoking paraphernalia. This would have the effect of authorizing the New York City Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings ("OATH") to adjudicate violations of Article 13-F. I support the goals of this legislation, which will authorize OATH to adjudicate violations of Article 13-F, relieving a significant burden for the New York City Department of Consumer and Worker Protection, the agency…

sponsored.t: Makes rent stabilized dwelling units eligible for certain protections
sponsored.sum: Requires that the entire amount of a rental deposit or advance be refundable to the tenant upon the tenant's vacating of the premises except for an amount lawfully retained for non-payment of rent or utilities, damage caused by the tenant, or storage costs; requires landlord to provide an itemized statement of damages and to return the balance of the deposit within 14 days; requires that tenant be given the opportunity to inspect the rental premises prior to signing a lease; allows a grantee or assignee of the leased premises to demand that an escrow account be opened.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of members of the Battery Park city authority
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment of members of the Battery Park city authority; increases the number of members to nine; requires five of the nine members be primary residents of Battery Park city.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 49 TO THE SENATE: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Senate Bill Number 3211, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to the appointment of members of the Battery Park city authority" NOT APPROVED This bill would change the composition of the Battery Park City Authority's (BPCA) board of directors by adding two more directors and requiring that a majority of the directors be residents of Battery Park City. I am committed to good government that is responsive to the needs of the communities served by the State's agencies and authorities. However, I previously vetoed this same bill due to concerns that it would impede the effective administration of BPCA. Those issues remain. The bill could give rise to conflicts of interest, which would impede the Board's ability to manage its business affairs in an orderly…

sponsored.t: Relates to succession rights for tenants of New York city housing authority properties
sponsored.sum: Relates to succession rights for tenants of New York city housing authority properties.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the COVID-19 emergency rental assistance program
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to payments under the COVID-19 emergency rental assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation
sponsored.sum: Increases the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation from nineteen billion dollars to twenty billion dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to extended producer responsibility for carpet
sponsored.sum: Limits liability of producers, representative organizations and retailers for antitrust, restraint of trade, or unfair trade practices arising from the performance of an action required to be undertaken under certain law or a producer plan.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of funds that may be used per dwelling unit to modernize certain authorities used by the housing trust fund corporation
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of funds that may be used per dwelling unit to modernize certain authorities used by the housing trust fund corporation.

sponsored.t: Codifies the disparate impact standard in the human rights law
sponsored.sum: Codifies the disparate impact standard in the human rights law; provides that in cases of alleged housing discrimination, an unlawful discriminatory practice may be established by a practice's discriminatory effect.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers of the New York state housing finance agency
sponsored.sum: Extends certain powers of the New York state housing finance agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice to be provided prior to a foreclosure action by a homeowners' association
sponsored.sum: Requires notice to be provided ninety days prior to commencement of a foreclosure action by a homeowners' association or condominium board to enforce a lien for unpaid common charges, assessments, fines or fees.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discriminatory practices by real estate appraisers and furthers fair housing compliance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discriminatory practices by real estate appraisers; furthers fair housing compliance.

sponsored.t: Increases the New York state housing finance agency bonding authority
sponsored.sum: Increases the New York state housing finance agency bonding authority to $36,280,000,000.

sponsored.t: Includes information on congenital heart defect births as part of the department of health's health care and wellness education and outreach program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Includes information on congenital heart defect births as part of the department of health's health care and wellness education and outreach program; amends the effectiveness thereof.
